set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.0; milestone-exchange.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: MappingExchange, MappingExchangeBuild/CLI and independent-reader miniature are landed, including 6a310fe3 workspace policy selection. Old notes calling solo/mapping-exchange unlanded are superseded; component export does not close the paired facade journey.

Remaining / next action: Complete paired reference/reconstruction publication and facade integration with the independent Python/R reader. Validate complete outcomes, exact ticks, joins and interruption/foreign/digest refusals through the public path.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Governing plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md (2026-09-19); ADR 0019. Key: exports; lane: next.

Scope: codec exchange writer/reader, pipeline export, examples

Acceptance criteria:
1. Document TSV quoting and types plus JSON manifest; export target/word/unit/support/measure/decision tables from one checked result; declare optional capabilities explicitly. No inference is reconstructed from display strings.
2. Independent Python or R reader checks hashes, joins, all outcomes, stage policies, exact ticks and interval membership; reproduces independently authored target-mass, exact-support and outcome-accounting answers without importing Scala exporter logic.
3. Schema rejects duplicate/missing keys, foreign source/recall identity, digest mismatch, unsupported versions and partial publication unless explicitly requested. Do not round authoritative measures or cast exact ticks through floating point.
4. Reference and structured views coexist with common evidence digest and separate policies/decisions. Calibration unavailable stays explicit; consumer sees ambiguity and coverage limitations.

Validation: proposed MappingExchangeSuite; python3 examples/mapping/read_mapping.py <miniature> (path to be implemented)

Completion evidence: exact baseline/result SHA, executable command and bound test totals/exit, artifact digests, discriminating failure injection, compatibility impact, separate SD6 review. Run reference-scope for the actual diff and SD2 checkAll before landing. Proposed suite names below are acceptance specifications, not existing or executed tests. No efficacy claim follows from a synthetic pass.

Boundary: One downstream language is enough; no viewer or Parquet requirement.

2026-09-22 operative workflow reconciliation (docs/plans/2026-09-22-recall-encoding-workflow.md):
Basic mapping exchange no longer depends on organization-readout implementation. Transition-table production, its checked wire/reader joins and independently authored tiny transition-answer acceptance move together to the existing full G2 preview integration ticket bd-01M2WVJ8HKX6EHG2C5CXYEZYJ6. A package without them declares organization/transition capability unavailable; an empty table must not imply zero transitions. The preview still depends on synthetic recovery, which depends on organization and compatibility. Temporal projections are separately bound packages over the same mapping identity, never a second mapping schema. Export original measure kind, normalization domain, full-precision values, top-k remainder, unallocated/external mass, policy/version and typed missingness. A consumer can request only admitted capabilities; missing optional temporal/scan/calibration support does not invalidate a valid base mapping package.
